simple.meaning: אַלְלַי (ʼalᵉlay) is a Hebrew word meaning “alas!.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַלְלַי (H480) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 10:15, with occurrences in Job, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַלְלַי (H480) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַלְלַי (H480) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַלְלַי (ʼalᵉlay) / H480 is traced through Job 10:15, Micah 7:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
